entry_points.text: Early identification clears state, branches on CPUID availability through enumeration, vendor, capability, address, cmdline, topology, hooks, filtering, dependency and machine check work, always forces a baseline and refreshes defects and speculation. Central bug setup combines whitelist absence with capability negatives and blacklist hits to mark exposures before mitigation.

Flags entry saves flags to the return register and branch entry exercises indirect protection via a loaded address. Percpu enable sets address protection as a hotplug step on all online CPUs when enabled, otherwise finalization idles.

exports.text: Control stores, shadow sync, early init, direct and fixed GDT loaders and the combined switch are public. Init starts from hardware, adds translation when supported, reapplies pinned bits when armed, writes hardware and refreshes shadow. Loaders build descriptors from percpu base with length size minus one. Switch loads direct table then sets base or reloads segment by build, discarding uncopied content.

Vendor, detection, capability, address, TLB, scan, dependency, unlock, machine check, scalable, topology, domain, AMD, extended and type helpers are public. Sizing uses build defaults without CPUID or low level, else widths from leaf bytes with mirrored cache. Detection defaults family four then derives geometry and alignment. TLB delegates to a hook then logs by size. Capability sampling merges scattered, speculation and syscall synthesis then reapplies forced masks.

hazards.text: Serial suppression is build divergent: one variant touches configuration, clears the capability and refreshes the maximum, while the other does nothing.

invariants.text: Early options run before bringup: no-save clears save variants, fred off clears flexible return, clear and set lists force bits, pcid, invpcid and fsgsbase need empty args and stay silent without boot support, key protection has a disable flag, cache size parses an integer with negative meaning none, serial clears suppression, nop is forced except 32 bit, and any effective use warns and marks out of specification.

Cached state scans static descriptors over a base range. Fill walks ranges and reset skips outsiders, zeroes registers plus metadata for covered entries, always reads the anchor to learn the maximum, then reads only entries at or below it. Clearing zeroes a bounded group plus info. Maximum uses subleaf zero of leaf zero for the base range and zero otherwise.

Enabled features need prerequisites else warn once with names or numeric fallback. Leaf-gated features withdraw below required levels with signed standard versus extended handling. Forced masks reapply after each probe across capability plus bug words. Scattered entries validate level then set the feature when the subleaf bit is present.

Legacy detection separates 486 from 386 by flag mutability, iterates vendor handlers until a string appears, then resolves identity. Model names need a minimum extended level, gather three leaves, then strip leading and trim trailing blanks. Legacy lookup range checks the index and walks a vendor table for a family match. Flag mutability toggles via stack on one build and always succeeds on the other.

Supervisor execution and access enable only when advertised, with access requiring the user flag already clear as fatal. User instruction restriction needs boot plus build plus current gates, logs once on success and explicitly clears stale enablement otherwise.

Tests need CPU match plus mask overlap. MMIO immunity needs three absences together. Register file uses immunity, clear-for-migration and blacklist with model gates. Indirect target needs missing immunity plus Intel plus absent branch control and then virtualization or blacklist. Microcode passes unknown and virtualized runs, treats a debug bit as stale, else compares versions.

Parsing starts unknown with invalid cache identities, honors fake override and seeds APIC identity from a fixed leaf. AMD tries modern parsing then older leaves for threads, geometry, nodes and cache, defaulting cache from shifted APIC and advertising distributed cache for multinode. Zero shift with multiple CPUs derives a corrected shift with one warning. A narrow AMD window re enables extensions and on success sets the capability and logs once.

Unlocking is empty generically and gated by Intel vendor plus minimum version, clearing a limit control and refreshing the cached maximum only on change. Quirks tune boot logging, overflow recovery, fetch workarounds and monarch synchronization by family and model. Scalable bootstrap has a full form assigning vectors and an empty fallback selected by capability.
Package thread count starts at one and becomes immutable after init.

locks.text: Shadow updates need interrupts disabled, verified by assertion, writing hardware only when the value differs.

state_machines.text: Pinning snapshots the shadow restricted to a fixed mask and arms enforcement. Later stores rewrite drift back and warn once, guarding write protect for one register and the mask for the other, which can hide caller errors.

Synthesis expands generic control into branch mitigations plus register control, mirrors vendor controls, derives stop predictions from either input, and drops the virtual stop bit when the direct bit is present.

Vendor scan compares up to two strings and adopts the first match, else falls back to generic with one instability error and possibly missing hooks. Generic init detects cache sizes on one build and labels very old CPUs on the other, starting as Unknown. Single domain update writes one level while set propagates upward.

Identifier setup matches, reads safely, abandons on failure or locked off, enables when off and rereads, then captures and advertises when enabled else withdraws. Key protection honors disable on the boot CPU before forcing the OS capability, later CPUs gate on that flag, then all set the bit and load rights. Enforcement programs state, sets the bit, self tests and unwinds on failure. Teardown idles unless either path was on.

structs.text: Control descriptions pair one capability index with two register selectors. Dependent records pair a feature with a required level and end with zero. Vulnerability tables pair matchers with immunity or affected masks via generic, versioned and family helpers, Intel bounded by stepping ranges, all with an empty terminator. Matching covers two vendors plus legacy models lacking enumeration. Generic family entries must follow specific ones or shadow them.

Seven counters track last level instruction entries by three sizes and data by four including a very large page. A percpu pointer reaches the current entry area. Leaf registers and metadata are reached by adding a caller displacement to the collection base, keeping descriptors compact.

Immunity: speculation 0, meltdown 1, store bypass 2, L1 fault 3, sampling 4, MSBDS only 5, swapgs 6, ITLB multihit 7, Spectre V2 8, MMIO 9, branch PBRSB 10, branch history 11; affected: sync buffer 0, MMIO 1, shared buffer 2, return bleed 3, SMT return stack 4, speculative return 5, gather 6, register file 7, indirect target 8, indirect native only 9, transient scheduler 10, virtual escape 11. Pinned mask combines SMEP, SMAP, UMIP, FSGSBASE and CET. Leaves are 0x1F then 0x0B, AMD 0x80000026, legacy 0x80000008 and 0x8000001E, hybrid 0x1A, APIC from leaf 1, plus a family 10h node fallback.
